Package growthbook.sdk.java.evaluators

Class ConditionEvaluator

java.lang.Object
growthbook.sdk.java.evaluators.ConditionEvaluator
All Implemented Interfaces:
IConditionEvaluator
public class ConditionEvaluator extends Object implements IConditionEvaluator
INTERNAL: Implementation of condition evaluation.

Public only so the evaluators package can share it; it is not part of the supported API. Even so, getPath(com.google.gson.JsonElement, java.lang.String) and isOperatorObject(com.google.gson.JsonElement) keep the exact return types published in 0.11.0: a return type is part of the JVM method descriptor, so narrowing one is a NoSuchMethodError for anything linked against that release, which no compiler warns about. Internally use resolvePath(com.google.gson.JsonElement, java.lang.String) and isOperatorObjectInternal(com.google.gson.JsonElement), which carry the precise types.

    • evaluateCondition

      public Boolean evaluateCondition(com.google.gson.JsonObject attributes, com.google.gson.JsonObject conditionJson, @Nullable com.google.gson.JsonObject savedGroups)
      Evaluate a condition for a set of user attributes based on the provided condition. The condition syntax closely resembles MongoDB's syntax. This is defined in the Feature's targeting conditions' Advanced settings.
      Specified by:
      evaluateCondition in interface IConditionEvaluator
      Parameters:
      attributes - A JsonObject of the user attributes to evaluate
      conditionJson - A JsonObject of the condition
      Returns:
      Whether the condition should be true for the user

    • isOperatorObject

      public Boolean isOperatorObject(com.google.gson.JsonElement object)
      Returns a boxed Boolean to keep the signature published in 0.11.0: a return type is part of the JVM method descriptor, so narrowing it to boolean is a NoSuchMethodError for callers compiled against that release. The value is never null; prefer isOperatorObjectInternal(com.google.gson.JsonElement) inside this class.
      Parameters:
      object - The object to evaluate
      Returns:
      true if the object is empty or every key is an operator (starts with $)

    • getPath

      @Nullable public Object getPath(com.google.gson.JsonElement attributes, String path)
      Resolves a dot-separated path against the attributes.

      Declared as Object to keep the signature published in 0.11.0, for the same binary-compatibility reason as isOperatorObject(com.google.gson.JsonElement). Every value it can return is a JsonElement or null; use resolvePath(com.google.gson.JsonElement, java.lang.String) inside this class to get that type without a cast.

      Parameters:
      attributes - User attributes
      path - String path, e.g. path.to.something
      Returns:
      the value at that path, or null if the path doesn't exist
